name: Bun
one_liner: JavaScript runtime, package manager, bundler and test runner in one binary.
what_it_is: A JavaScript runtime built on JavaScriptCore rather than V8, bundling a package manager, bundler, test runner and TypeScript support into a single fast executable, with substantial Node.js API compatibility.
why_it_matters: Bun is the consolidation argument applied to the whole toolchain rather than one layer. Many teams adopt it only as a package manager, which is a low-risk way to get most of the benefit. Treat the runtime as emerging: Node compatibility is good and improving but not total, and that gap is exactly where production surprises live.
suitable_for: Fast package installs, as a drop-in npm replacement
Scripts and tooling where startup time matters
Greenfield projects willing to track a fast-moving runtime
not_suitable_for: Production services depending on native Node addons or less-common Node APIs
Teams needing the operational maturity and long-term support Node provides
